story: Rotaractors from across the Nakuru Region came together for a meeting with the District Governor. The engagement offered time to connect, share ideas and learn from leadership while strengthening the clubs’ commitment to community service.

During the same occasion, Rotaract Club of Menengai inducted six members: Mitchelle Blessings (Lawyer), Marion Kaggia (Nurse), Hannah Maina (Social Work), Morris Mulitu (Software Engineer), Eliah Kinyanjui (Business) and June Wanja (Sales & Marketing).
The club welcomed the new members and the skills and experience they bring to its service and fellowship.
outcome: Six members joined Menengai during a regional engagement with the District Governor.

story: On 17 September 2026, Menengai joined a 10-day Friendship Exchange in India through President Wanjiku. She travelled as part of a six-person delegation from Rotary District 9215, with a programme across Mumbai, Palghar and Pune.

Families welcomed the delegates into their homes. Time with hosts, Rotary meetings and Rotaract fellowship gave the visitors a chance to share club experiences and learn how fellow members organised their work. Letterhead exchanges marked those meetings between clubs.

During the visit, club presidents exchanged official club letterheads. For Menengai, the exchange marked friendship across borders and an opportunity to share culture, ideas and approaches to service with fellow Rotaract clubs.

The visit also included Ganpati celebrations, university visits, historic sites, temples and beaches. These encounters placed the fellowship alongside the places and traditions of the communities receiving the delegation.
outcome: For Menengai, Wanjiku’s participation brought the club into direct fellowship with Rotary and Rotaract members in India. The exchange created personal connections through shared homes, club meetings and cultural visits, with host families central to the experience.

story: Menengai opened its Rotary-year service programme at Bondeni Maternity with a donation of 48 Mother Packs. Twenty-two new mothers received packs on the day; the donation total and same-day recipients are separate counts.
Rotary Club of Davis supported the initiative in partnership with Menengai’s sponsor club, Rotary Club of Nakuru.
County Government CEC Roselyn Mungai and Dr. Joyce Yator, Doctor in Charge at Bondeni Maternity, attended. Rotarians, Rotaractors, donors and volunteers supported the preparation and delivery.
outcome: 48 Mother Packs donated; 22 new mothers received packs during the visit.

story: Menengai and Rotaract Club of Bahati came together for the Mother Pack Project at Kabatini Health Center, supporting mothers and families with essential items.
Each pack included a basin, uji flour, soap, tissue, a face towel, heavy-flow pads, diapers, cooking oil and other essentials.
The clubs served alongside Rotaract Club of Naivasha, Rotaract Club of Thika TTI, Rotaract Club of University of Embu and Rotary Club of Kisumu Winam.

story: During Empowering Minds, Menengai members spent time with learners at Pangani Special School through art and creativity sessions, writing clinics, reading and storytelling.
The club donated essential supplies and sanitary products through its Girls’ Support Drive to support the learners.
District Rotaract Representative Brian Magana joined the activity. Members, donors and volunteers contributed materials, time and encouragement throughout the day.

story: On 31 May 2025, Menengai’s Sports Legacy Project brought young people together through sports. District Grant DG2677765 supported opportunities for youth engagement, talent development and positive community interaction.

The activities promoted teamwork, discipline, leadership and healthy living. Participants built relationships through a shared sporting experience, with inclusion and community connection at the centre of the initiative.
outcome: A youth sports initiative supported through District Grant DG2677765. Participant totals and grant amounts have not been supplied.
